name: 5-LightGBM ensemble (uniform/exp/dist/x/recent)
tagline: Train 5 LightGBM models with uniform, exponential-recency, validation-distribution, multiplicative, and recent-only sample weights; aggregate via daily-IC softmax.
init_recovers: Uniform LGBM if all $\alpha$ collapse to $w_u$
diff_from_baseline: Replaces single LightGBM with a 5-weighting ensemble; new weight schemes are validation-feature-distribution similarity per quarter and the multiplicative time$\times$distribution scheme; aggregation uses daily-IC-proportional weights.

name: TGA-Net: adversarial temporal alignment + experts
tagline: MLP encoder with 3 expert heads, gradient-reversal temporal-period discriminator, recency-weighted loss, expert-decorrelation, and inverse-loss expert gating.
init_recovers: Vanilla MLP regression at GRL=0, decorr=0, equal-expert weights
diff_from_baseline: End-to-end neural model: replaces qlib's LightGBM/TRA with a 3-expert MLP, adds gradient-reversal temporal-domain discriminator and softmax-of-negative-loss expert gating; recency-weighted MSE objective.

name: Regime-routed LightGBM mixture
tagline: Train one global LightGBM plus 6 chronological-regime LightGBMs; at test, per-month softmax over Euclidean distances to regime feature centroids.
init_recovers: Plain global LightGBM if mixture weight collapses onto $\mathrm{LGBM}_{global}$
diff_from_baseline: Adds an explicit temporal-regime mixture: 6 specialist LightGBMs gated at inference by softmax-over-Euclidean-z to median feature centroids of each regime, blended 50/50 with a single global LightGBM.

name: Two-halflife Ridge+ExtraTrees with shift gate
tagline: Long- and short-halflife recency-weighted Ridge+ExtraTrees experts blended per day by a sigmoid gate of feature-distribution drift.
init_recovers: Single Ridge + ExtraTrees regressor at gate $\to 0.5$ and blend $w^* = 0.5$
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the LightGBM-only pipeline with Ridge+ExtraTrees stacked experts at two recency halflives and an explicit per-day distribution-shift sigmoid gate that mixes them.

name: Stable / adaptive MLP twin with MMD + fine-tune
tagline: Twin MLPs (stable + adaptive) with exp-recency loss, RBF-MMD alignment between past/recent in the adaptive branch, and a recent-only fine-tune.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces qlib's LightGBM with a twin-MLP architecture: stable branch on uniform-ish recency, adaptive branch with $w_t^{1.5}$ recency, RBF-MMD between past/recent latent codes, and a 30-epoch recent-only fine-tune of the adaptive head.
